## Dispatch order · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-27T00:42Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26298, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26298" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`), and the audit it comes from (#26184 comment 6425678185, Part A, § objectstack-automation); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26298` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26298 --file=F` (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Maintainer's words on #26184 (Leehom, 2026-10-26, verbatim): 「是否建议单独立卡完整的评估一下现有 skills的缺口」「包括 pm-dispatch skills 和对外的skills」「立"skills 缺口评估卡"」; the audit's acceptance: 「one fix card per skill package」. Triage first grade for the eight audit cards is one anchor on #26184, comment 6425930271 (⛔ not a claim): this card is **p2** (per the batch anchor), `domain:skills`, Tier H (`skills/**` is a published surface). The rows below are the card's Measured section; teach exactly those, nothing wider: the card's 「Wanted」 is the whole scope.

### Scope and tier

File surface: `skills/objectstack-automation/**` only — the files the card names plus the package's `evals/*.json` and, if the package carries one, `references/_index.md` (run `pnpm gen:skill-refs` if the index is generated; read `package.json` scripts). `skills/**` is a PUBLISHED surface on the governed register ⇒ the whole PR is **Tier H**: it stays a draft; the seat runs the independent `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review; the maintainer's hand (or an authorized APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`) lands it. ⛔ You never ready, arm or enqueue it. `dispatch-gates --tier` for `skills/**`: MANDATORY ceiling tier with no one-line exit — that is why your thread runs at the tier it does.

`os-dev.md` 290–291 bind: the PR body reports TWO readings, the whole-file before/after line count of every changed `.md` file and the whole-package before/after (the sum over `SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`), and the default is to REFUSE a small feature written large: teach each row in the fewest lines that an AI author needs, pay additions inside the package where a stale or duplicated line exists, and remove nothing beyond the stale lines the card names. Package reading at dispatch: package 995 lines (SKILL.md 432, references/_index.md 46, references/examples-flows.md 134, references/state-machines-and-approvals.md 383); evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json 55 lines.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at dispatch (seat's subagent, 2026-10-27 00:36Z): **holds.**
1. 0 hits in the package for `requiredPermissions`, `excludeSubmitter`, `emailField`; `SKILL.md:107` reads "REQUIRED — id, list, or envelope" (the trap the card names); the approval config table in `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` ~344–351 has no `excludeSubmitter` row.
2. Spec: `excludeSubmitter` in `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` (12 hits; refused beside `onEmptyApprovers: 'auto_approve'` — quote the refusal); `emailField` in `io-node-config.zod.ts` (17 hits, description at 278; a computed address no user holds fails the node at run time); flow `requiredPermissions` at `flow.zod.ts:1220` (ADR-0066 D4). Commits `49653f9181`, `4bcc4df649`, `6021b5e837`, `d1e329e96d` exist.
3. The screen field typed `file` (commit `6d9d3ef857`): the seat's premise read did not find its spec location — locate it before teaching it (grep `packages/spec/src/automation` for the screen field type enum); if it is not in the spec on `main`, teach only what is, and report the row as not-on-main.
4. Eval: 0 hits for `emailField` / `excludeSubmitter` in `flows-triggers-approvals.json` — the "email the applicant when the application is approved" eval expecting `recipients: { emailField: … }` is new.

### Card-specific clauses

- Every new teaching gets an eval prompt in the package's `evals/*.json` (`flows-triggers-approvals.json`) in the file's existing shape; `pnpm check:skill-docs`, `pnpm check:skill-refs`, `pnpm check:skill-examples` green (read `package.json` for the exact script names; if a name differs, run the one that exists and say so).
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26298`, then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial (the skill teaches keys the protocol already carries), then the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的; this is a Tier H PR, so 需要你做的 names the one action: approve, or 「Merge when ready」), then `## What changes`, `## Tests`, `## Acceptance notes`, `## Verification` with log readings folded into details/summary blocks. `skip-changeset` in `pr_create`'s `labels` (the skills packages carry no `package.json`; nothing is released). Name nothing beside `#26298` with a closing keyword; other card numbers appear only with zero verbs beside them.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26298`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- Serial: PR #25640 (version packages) touches line 1 of every `skills/*/SKILL.md` (frontmatter version); do not edit that line. No open PR touches `skills/objectstack-automation/**` beyond #25640's version line.
- Commit trailers: the model-free pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them; ⛔ no model name anywhere in the commit or PR.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26298 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations`, `line_budget` (per `.md` file before/after and the package total before/after) and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 with the PR number, head sha and the report's key points; keep your thread open through the review (a FAIL comes back to you).
